paymentsPageDescription: A record of every payment made for your bookings.
noPaymentsDescription: Payments for your bookings will appear here.
paymentRecordDescription: This is a record of your payment, generated from your booking's payment data — not a separately issued fiscal document.
invoiceNotIssuedLabel: Invoice not issued for this booking.
providerPaymentsPageDescription: The real, captured or refunded state of payments for your bookings.
noProviderPaymentsDescription: Payments for your bookings will appear here.
earningsVsPaymentsDescription: Earnings above is an operational estimate derived from your bookings' price snapshots. Payments reflects the real, captured or refunded state of each transaction. The two are calculated independently and are never merged or subtracted from one another.
paymentsAdminDescription: Search and inspect payment records. Read-only — no capture or refund action is available here.
noPaymentsAdminDescription: Payment records will appear here once bookings are accepted.
adminActionsDeferredNote: Capture and refund actions exist in the backend for this Payment but are intentionally not exposed in this admin interface.
